review.rationale: The Decision correctly authorizes only the preparation of the exact 16-file offline input-binding supplement, explicitly rejecting current CE-G13 execution and withholding all offline validation and live execution authority. The 16-file scope is strictly enumerated and bounded to non-executable JSON/Markdown artifacts. The immutable 28-file base package is preserved with mutation forbidden. The four input-binding contracts (Sanitized Public Input Bundle, Model Input Envelope, Execution Output Manifest, Outcome Policy) comprehensively cover the material gaps identified in the Recommendation. The 26-file future execution output allowlist is independently verified as sound (1+1+1+1+1+5+5+5+1+1+1+1+1+1=26). The preparation boundary correctly permits only authoring, static JSON parsing, and hash computation while forbidding schema validation, candidate validation, negative cases, offline validation runs, and all execution activities. Offline validation is explicitly not authorized and requires a separate future decision. The commit gate is fail-closed with zero retries, fallbacks, or substitutions. All execution non-authorizations are complete and comprehensive. Authority boundaries are fully preserved with no elevation or ownership changes. The Recommendation chain is valid with the v0.2 replacement document properly superseding the failed v0.1 attempt, and the qualifying review correctly identifies Option A as the appropriate bounded supplement approach.
